record.question: Which of the following is not a feature of a supernumerary post?
options: Supernumerary posts are personal to the officer(s) to whom the post is created
It shall stand abolished as soon the officer(s) for whom it is created vacates it on account of retirement, promotion or on accommodation against a regular post
The supernumerary post may be filled up by direct recruitment after the retirement of the incumbent
The Competent Authority for creation of posts and procedure with respect to supernumerary posts shall be the same as for regular posts
